research_question: Does fold-specific AutoEncoder adaptation recover held-out Condition 3 Level ordering when interpreter-only adaptation fails?
scope_note: Movement is not scored because independently retrained AutoEncoders define new latent coordinate systems incompatible with the frozen Condition 1 Residual-GRU.

decision_rules.encoder_adaptation_supported_if: Held-out Level rho is positive for all three bearings and improves at least two bearings versus frozen baseline.
decision_rules.otherwise: Do not consume Bearing3_4; investigate health-aware or nonlinear representations on development bearings.
